method: Sear your protein, then set aside once nicely browned.
In the same pan, fry the shallots and leek with a drizzle of olive oil until they start to soften.
Deglaze the pan with the white wine.
Add the beans, stock and protein, then cook over medium heat until the liquid has reduced by about half, around 10 minutes.
Stir in the mustard and cream, then cook for another 10 minutes, or until thickened to your liking.
Plate the beans and top with the protein. Season lightly: jarred butter beans are already salted.
